rawContent: FEB & MARCH: We kicked off my digital writing residency at @shme_bbk @BirkbeckUoL with this great panel with @bourke_joanna @AminaMemon1 🙌 I was also thrilled to give a talk for @NEXUS_NI @VictimSupportNI at their annual conference #MeToo #endVAWG https://t.co/ic2VSYIfYk

MARCH: I also delivered a talk on surviving rape & the power of the arts community to an audience of professionals who work against sexual violence at the annual @StmarysSARC conference. Centering the survivor’s voice is always key 💪 #MeToo #endVAWG #DarkChapter https://t.co/mp6ym3qPas

MAY: Another beautiful, affirming literary panel with @hilarymcc7 @Macha_NI @Shelleytracey as part of my collaboration with @NEXUS_NI via a @ArtsCouncilNI grant. #MeToo #endVAWG #writerscommunity You can watch it here: https://t.co/2OXBf7gOgv https://t.co/70cymu4zBA

JUNE: We revamped the @clearlinesuk website & launched this fantastic FREE #creativewriting guide for survivors of sexual abuse & violence, by the excellent @ShareClaw (thanks to a @RSLiterature #LiteratureMatters grant) ✍️ #MeToo Get the guide here https://t.co/v5rwKaqva6

SEPT: I finished Draft 1 of the #screenplay adaptation of #DarkChapter thanks to @cheevil @NIScreen @BFI 👩🏻‍💻 Adapting my semi-autobiographical 1st novel for #film was a long-held dream. Writing it was creatively exciting but emotionally challenging (given the topic) #MeToo https://t.co/CiQhiFRN0M

NOV: I recorded this lecture for a @iocmedia certificate course for safeguarding officers who work in sports. How can we best champion victims & survivors when there is media interest in sexual assault cases? #MeToo #endVAWG https://t.co/0jPsGvVyB3

Finally DEC 2021! Galleys for the #US edition of #Complicit @AtriaBooks arrived & a load of @goodreads readers wanted them. And these gorgeous UK proofs @orionbooks started to make their way into the world… I’m hoping many readers enjoy it in 2022! #authorlife #amwriting #MeToo https://t.co/0PDxWTuImJ

📣📣 Deadline: Mon, Jan 17! Apply for this vital role at @WomenandGirlsN advocating for Black women who have experienced sexual violence. You can make a huge difference to victims as an ISVA. More info 👉👉https://t.co/Yf65a9uLmj #endVAWG #MeToo #BreakTheSilence #MeToomvmt https://t.co/uRb8Z37PvS
